title: Fantasy football 2026 draft kit: Rankings, cheat sheet, projections, sleepers and more
author: Jake Ciely
content:
The wait for the 2026 fantasy football season is finally over, and drafts are underway.

Luckily, The Athletic’s draft kit includes everything you need to dominate your draft (or auction), from rankings and player projections to sleepers and breakouts. And of course, there’s the Cheat Sheet, a fully customizable tool that allows you to input our league settings and get a set of rankings and point projections unique to your team — all from the mind of Jake Ciely, who is among the most accurate prognosticators in the game.

Each week (and often day) until the first regular-season game, this kit will continue to expand, so check back often for updates.
